about.heading: About
paragraphs: Hi! 👋   My name is Mrinmay Das. I’m a passionate technology enthusiast and a B.Tech student of Academy Of Technology, with a strong interest in Data Science, Machine Learning, and Full-Stack Development. I love building innovative projects that combine programming, AI, and real-world applications.

Over time, I’ve developed hands-on experience with Python, SQL, React.js, Flask, and FastAPI, and I enjoy exploring both backend and frontend development. I’ve worked on projects ranging from AI-powered applications, predictive models, and web apps to automation tools.
about.objective: To challenge myself in a new environment to learn, develop, and improve my skills through different projects, and try new things.
